meta.title: Simbly Pet: Dog & Cat Care App for Health Records and Bookings
meta.description: Keep your pet's health records, vaccinations and reminders in one place, share them with family, and book grooming, boarding and daycare with trusted local businesses.

hero.eyebrow: One app for your pet's health and care
hero.subtitle: Health records, vaccination reminders and bookings with trusted groomers, boarders and daycares, all in one app you can share with the whole family.

statement: One home for your pet's health, care and every booking, shared with everyone who loves them.

features.title: Everything your pet needs, in your pocket

items.title: Health records that stay with them
items.body: Vaccinations, deworming, medications, checkups, allergies and weight, kept in one tidy timeline you can pull up at any clinic.

items.title: Reminders that set themselves
items.body: Log a vaccination with its next due date and the reminder is created for you.

items.title: Share with family
items.body: Invite a co-owner or family member so everyone sees the same records and reminders.

items.title: Made for dogs and cats
items.body: Profiles, health records and reminders built around dogs and cats, whether you have one pet or a house full of both.

items.title: Book trusted services
items.body: Request grooming, boarding or daycare with verified local businesses and get a confirmed time back.

items.title: Photo updates and reports
items.body: Before-and-after grooming photos and updates during a stay, sent straight to your phone.

how.title: From first vaccine to every visit

steps.title: Add your pet
steps.body: Create a profile with species, breed, birthday and microchip. Add as many pets as you have.

steps.title: Keep their health history
steps.body: Record vaccinations, deworming, medications and weight, with documents attached, so nothing lives on scraps of paper.

steps.title: Never miss a due date
steps.body: Next due dates become reminders automatically, and everyone you've shared the pet with stays in the loop.

steps.title: Book in a couple of taps
steps.body: Pick a service from a verified business, choose a time and send a request. The business confirms or suggests another slot.

steps.title: See how their day went
steps.body: Get grooming reports with before-and-after photos, and photo updates while they're boarding.

services.title: Trusted local businesses, one app
services.subtitle: Every business on Simbly Pet is reviewed and verified by our team before it can take bookings.

items.title: Grooming
items.body: Baths, haircuts and nail trims, with a report and before-and-after photos when it's done.

items.title: Boarding
items.body: Overnight stays with your care instructions, check-in and check-out times, and photo updates.

items.title: Daycare
items.body: Daytime care while you're busy. Book a day, drop off, and see how it went.

items.title: Vet clinics
items.body: Clinic visits that go straight into your pet's health history.

business.title: Run your pet business, simbly.
business.subtitle: Groomers, boarders and daycares use Simbly Pet to take bookings, organise their team and keep pet parents happy.

points.title: Bookings and calendar
points.body: Accept requests, add walk-ins and see the whole day at a glance.

points.title: Staff and branches
points.body: Roles and permissions for every team member, across every branch.

points.title: Customers and pets
points.body: Every pet's details and history, ready before they arrive.

points.title: Reports parents love
points.body: Send grooming reports and stay photo updates from your phone.

items.q: Which pets does Simbly Pet support?
items.a: Simbly Pet is built for dogs and cats. Add as many as you have, and share each one with your family.

items.q: Can my family see my pet's records?
items.a: Yes. Invite a co-owner or family member and they'll see the same profile, health history and reminders. You decide who has access.
Every business applies with its details and documents, and our team reviews them before the business can accept bookings.
Each business sets its own prices for its services. You'll see the price before you send a booking request.

items.q: I run a pet business. How do I join?
items.a: Register at business.simblypet.com. Once your business is verified, you can set up services, branches and staff and start taking bookings.

cta.title: Give your pet the care they deserve, without the effort.
cta.subtitle: The Simbly Pet app is coming soon to iPhone and Android.

meta.title: Simbly Pet for Businesses: bookings, staff and reports for pet care
meta.description: Groomers, boarders and daycares use Simbly Pet to take bookings, manage staff and branches, and send pet parents reports and photo updates.

hero.title: Run your pet business, simbly.
hero.subtitle: Bookings, staff, branches and customer pets in one place, with reports and photo updates that keep pet parents coming back.

audiences.title: One business, every service you offer
audiences.subtitle: Offer grooming, boarding and daycare from one account. Each service is added as a module and checked by our team.

items.title: Groomers
items.body: Bookings by service and add-on, groomer assignment, and before-and-after reports.

items.title: Boarding
items.body: Rooms and kennels with capacity limits, check-in and check-out, and a care log.

items.title: Daycare
items.body: Day bookings, drop-off and pick-up, and photo updates for parents during the day.

items.title: Vet clinics
items.body: Visit notes that go straight into each pet's health history.

items.title: Booking requests
items.body: Parents request a time in the app. Confirm it, decline it, or suggest another slot. Unanswered requests expire, so nobody is left waiting.

items.title: Calendar and walk-ins
items.body: See every branch's day at a glance. Add phone and walk-in bookings, even for customers who don't use the app.

items.title: Staff and roles
items.body: Owner, Admin, Manager, Receptionist, Groomer and more. Everyone sees only what their role allows.

items.title: Branches and hours
items.body: Run several locations with their own hours, closures, staff and prices. Branch staff only see their branch.

items.title: Services and pricing
items.body: Build your menu with variants, add-ons and prices per branch, and choose which pets each service is for.

items.title: Customers and pets
items.body: Every pet's details and visit history is ready before they arrive, including customers you add yourself.

items.title: Reports and photo updates
items.body: Send grooming reports with before-and-after photos and stay updates that parents see straight away.

items.title: Availability and time off
items.body: Set staff working hours and time off, and get a warning before a slot is overbooked.

items.title: Register
items.body: Fill in your business details and upload the documents the form asks for.

items.title: Get verified
items.body: Our team reviews your application. If anything is missing, we'll tell you what to fix.

items.title: Choose your services
items.body: Pick grooming, boarding or daycare. Each one is approved for your business.

items.title: Start taking bookings
items.body: Add branches, services and staff. Pet parents can then find you and book in the app.

items.q: I offer grooming and boarding. Do I need two accounts?
items.a: No. One business account covers every service you offer. Each service is added as a module.

items.q: Can I manage more than one branch?
items.a: Yes. Each branch has its own hours, closures, staff and prices, and you can limit staff to the branches they work at.

items.q: Can I add staff who don't use the app?
items.a: Yes. Add them by name and phone so you can assign bookings to them, and invite them to the app later if you want.
Our team reviews your details and documents. Once you're verified and your services are approved, you can set up and start taking bookings.

items.q: Can I take bookings from customers who aren't on Simbly Pet?
items.a: Yes. Add phone and walk-in bookings yourself, with the customer and pet details kept on your side.

cta.title: Ready to bring your business to Simbly Pet?
cta.subtitle: Register in a few minutes. Our team will verify your details and help you get set up.

home.title: Questions? Say hello.
home.subtitle: Send us a message and our team will get back to you by email.

points.title: Quick replies
points.body: We read every message and reply as soon as we can.

points.title: Run a pet business?
points.body: Pick "Business wanting to join" and tell us a little about it.

business.title: Want to bring your business on board?
business.subtitle: Tell us about your business and we'll help you get set up. Prefer to start now? Register at the business portal.

points.title: Verified businesses only
